LanguageData.PR.Settings.Games.Desc: Turning one off removes its right-click option. Colonists still use the furniture on their own.
LanguageData.PR.Settings.Pause: Pause the game while you play
LanguageData.PR.Settings.Pause.Desc: Off means colony time runs. The window closes itself when a threat shows up.
LanguageData.PR.Settings.Immersion.Desc: The window opens once the colonist reaches the furniture.
LanguageData.PR.Settings.Together: Pick an opponent and play together
LanguageData.PR.Settings.Together.Desc: Someone from the colony sits across from you. Their name goes on the board instead of a tier.
LanguageData.PR.Settings.Together.Range: Call someone from up to {0} tiles away
LanguageData.PR.Settings.Together.Invites: Guests sit down and ask for a game
LanguageData.PR.Settings.Together.Invites.Desc: Now and then a guest takes a seat at a free board and waits. Click the board and they are at the top of the list. If nobody joins them, they play on their own.
LanguageData.PR.Settings.Together.Personality: Their personality shows at the board
LanguageData.PR.Settings.Together.Personality.Desc: What they say to each other while playing appears in the log panel. The game does not write any of it — vanilla does.
LanguageData.PR.Settings.Together.BoardFlip: They can flip the board when angry
LanguageData.PR.Settings.Together.BoardFlip.Desc: A hyper-aggressive opponent who is losing may start a social fight, which ends the game. Off means only their words carry their temper.
LanguageData.PR.Settings.Together.KindUndo: A kind opponent gives you one more takeback
LanguageData.PR.Settings.Together.Goodwill: Playing with a visitor moves faction goodwill
LanguageData.PR.Settings.Together.Goodwill.Desc: A close game pleases them. Crushing a guest does not. Only the last game of a visit counts, and a low tier barely moves anything.
LanguageData.PR.Settings.Together.GoodwillDrop: It can go down as well as up
LanguageData.PR.Settings.LinkSkill: Set the tier from the colonist skill
LanguageData.PR.Settings.LinkSkill.Desc: Skips the picker. Each game uses its own skill.
LanguageData.PR.Settings.ThinkTime: Pause before they act: {0}s (shorter at higher tiers)
LanguageData.PR.Settings.Mastery.Explain: One step per tier you beat for the first time. +{0}% each, +{1}% for all of them. Tracked per game.
LanguageData.PR.Settings.MasteryBonus: Colonists get more out of the furniture as you improve
LanguageData.PR.Settings.PlayThought: Give colonists a thought after playing
LanguageData.PR.Settings.SaveSessions: Leave unfinished games on the furniture
LanguageData.PR.Settings.SaveSessions.Desc: Closing the window leaves the position where it is.
LanguageData.PR.Settings.Invalidate: A disturbed board loses the game on it
LanguageData.PR.Settings.Invalidate.Desc: Whatever happens around the furniture happens to the game.
LanguageData.PR.Settings.ExpiryDays: Forget it {0} days after you last touched it
LanguageData.PR.Settings.NoUndoHard: No undo at Excellent and Masterwork
